metadata.note: The drawn basemap with the ground taken out from under it. Same absence of tiles, glyphs, sprite and any other host; the difference is that this one also refuses the hillshade and the terrain, so there is no landform at all. Yerevan sits on a slope and the relief is worth seeing, which is why the drawn basemap keeps it; but the space-time cube is a few hundred hairlines standing in the air, and a shaded hillside under them is a photograph with a drawing lost on top of it. This ground exists for that case: the city as a plan, floating on nothing.
